# Credit Appraisal Notes

This document outlines critical tasks for credit appraisal and loan management:

*   Update the collateral value for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the borrower credit score quarterly.
*   Review the interest rates quarterly.
*   Investigate the default risk urgently.
*   Update the borrower credit score for strategy 2026.
